about.tool: A broad-edged pen held at about 40°.
about.proportions: x-height 5 nib widths; ascenders and capitals 1.36 x-heights, descenders 0.35; the stems a third of an x-height apart, so the white between them is as wide as a stem.
about.features: Textura Quadrata: dense vertical stems (minims) with diamond heads and feet, round letters broken into a box of stems, roof and foot, the d's back curving over its bowl, g and y closed by a heavy tail; wide capitals with doubled stems, diagonal hairlines, diamonds in the counters and thorns beside the stems. The long vertical hairlines that cross some capitals (drawn with the nib's corner) are left out here: a nib held at one angle draws every vertical thick.
about.history: The formal book hand of northern Europe from the 12th to the 15th century (Gutenberg's Bible is set in it); also Fraktur, Rotunda and Bâtarde.
